name: Joseph Nimmo, Jr.
role: Chief of the federal Bureau of Statistics; range-cattle writer
bio: Joseph Nimmo, Jr., chief of the Bureau of Statistics, wrote the government report on the range and ranch cattle business that the Cow Boy drew on for figures in July 1885. In November 1886 the paper reprinted his Harper's article on the American cowboy.

moments.label: His range-cattle report supplied the paper's figures
Harper's article on the cowboy reprinted
